description: Binary assertions for Auction Analyzer output quality. Used by Karpathy-style self-improvement loop.

tests.prompt: Analyze case 2024-CA-001234. ARV=$285,000, Repairs=$35,000, Judgment=$223,000. Calculate max bid and recommendation.
tests.expected_output: Max bid calculation with formula breakdown and BID/REVIEW/SKIP recommendation

assertions.description: Max bid formula applied: (ARV×0.70)-Repairs-$10K-MIN($25K,0.15×ARV)
Output contains explicit max_bid field as number (not string)
Bid/judgment ratio calculated correctly (max_bid / judgment_amount)
Recommendation matches threshold: bid_ratio >= 0.75 = BID, 0.60-0.74 = REVIEW, < 0.60 = SKIP
Output includes formula_breakdown object showing each step

tests.prompt: Analyze lien priority for case where HOA is plaintiff foreclosing against property with existing first mortgage. Determine lien survival.
tests.expected_output: Lien priority analysis showing senior mortgage survives HOA foreclosure per FL statute

assertions.description: Output identifies plaintiff_type as 'HOA' or 'Association'
Output flags senior_mortgage_survives as true
Lien priority order lists mortgage ABOVE HOA lien
Output includes warning or risk_flag field about surviving liens
Output does NOT recommend BID without acknowledging surviving mortgage impact on ARV

tests.prompt: Generate a one-page DOCX report for case 2024-CA-005678 with BCPAO photo, ML prediction, and recommendation.
tests.expected_output: Valid DOCX file with BidDeed.AI branding, no Property360 references

assertions.description: Generated DOCX file opens without validation errors
Document contains text 'BidDeed.AI' (house brand present)
Document does NOT contain 'Property360' or 'Mariam'
Document contains BCPAO photo URL or embedded image
Document contains ML prediction section with numeric confidence score

tests.prompt: Fetch property data from BCPAO for parcel 25-37-22-00-00049.0-0000.00. Return structured JSON.
tests.expected_output: BCPAO property record with owner, value, address, and photo URL

assertions.description: Output contains owner_name field (non-null string)
Output contains just_value field as positive number
Output contains property_address with FL zip code (5 digits)
Output contains photo_url field starting with https://
Output is valid JSON with no null required fields

tests.prompt: Analyze batch of 5 auction cases. Return summary with counts per recommendation category.
tests.expected_output: Batch analysis with per-case results and summary statistics

assertions.description: Output contains exactly 5 case results in results array
Summary contains bid_count + review_count + skip_count = 5
Every case in results has a non-empty case_number field
Summary includes total_judgment_amount as positive number
Every recommendation value is one of: BID, REVIEW, SKIP (no other values)
